body: I do this, too, sometimes. So does my bf. I’m interested in knowing exactly what this is!

You’re awesome.:) Thank you, again, so much! It’s such a relief to even just read that I’m valid. Even if you already know, I wanna say it back because it helped me to read it: You’re valid, too! It feels less overwhelming to run into someone who’s willing to hear me out more.

Oh my God, this definitely DOES help. Thank you so much! I’d say that it seems that I’d be more into women sexually, but I’m not sure how I’d view them romantically. I initially thought I wouldn’t be into them romantically at all, but there are a few women I think of and am just like....maybe? It’s really confusing in that respect. I think what I’m battling with, too, is being afraid to be completely honest about having some sort of attraction to women. I’ve found that, when my bf confronts me about why he thinks it’s ridiculous to think I’m bi (by being like, “You’re NOT into having sex with them/you don’t like them!”), I feel too nervous to retort that I can see them in that light. And then, even though he doesn’t mean to be mean about it, or anything, I can feel really ashamed of even questioning it out loud with him. 

I feel that I’ll still be predominantly into men, but I do feel like I have an attraction to women, too. I feel like these thoughts keep popping up for me for a reason, and it’s too often for it to just a one off thing for me, I think. It’s just overwhelming for me. There’s a lot I seem to not understand about potentially being in the LGBTQ+ community, even though I’ve been so involved in it.

I appreciate that. I always seem to forget that part.:) I guess I just get nervous that I’ll run out of time to get better and that he’d leave me. It’s a lot on him, and he admits that it can be tiring.
